items.title: Michael Wilson: Out for season with neck injury
items.description:
Coach Mike LaFleur revealed Monday that Wilson is out for the season due to a fracture in his neck, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: Finger surgery on tap, IR a possibility
items.description:
When asked if IR is a possibility for Jacobs (finger), coach Matt LaFleur said Monday, "I think everything is a possibility," Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: David Montgomery: Could return to practice soon
items.description:
Coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday he's hopeful that Montgomery (groin) could resume practicing this week, or next week, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jacoby Brissett: In line to start next Monday
items.description:
Ahead of Week 10, Ravens head coach Jesse Minter noted "I expect (Brissett) to be our starter" next Monday, Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: Reportedly set for finger surgery
items.description:
Jacobs is in line to undergo surgery on his injured finger this week and is expected to miss a maximum of three weeks, according to Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
